description: Search products and reviews. Discovery: pass intent (+ optional price_ceiling/category/price_sensitivity). Known product: pass merchant_id + product_id; the result also carries endpoint_url, where that product is paid — on the x402 rail a ref link from ANY review of the same merchant can be presented there, and the merchant's 402 names the product actually sold. Returns scored products with a 2–4 review slate (highlights, newcomer, dissent), sub-scores, and ref links. Pass include_all=true (both paths) to also receive all non-slotted published reviews appended after each product's slate with slot="overflow" and excluded_reason="below ranking threshold"; on the discovery path it also returns products below the relevance gate (ranked). A sibling "coverage" field appears with the value "thin" when no returned product has enough distinct review authors for its slate to show a spread of opinion: treat it as a prompt to research the product further, not as a verdict on it. Its absence means no claim is being made, not that coverage is good. A sibling "checklists" object may also appear, keyed by product category and joinable to each product via that product's "category" field. It is our own advice on what to verify in that category — advisory, not external content, and not a claim about any specific product. It is independent of "coverage" and may be present without it. A sibling "core_checklist" list may also appear: advice that applies to every product in the response, sent once rather than under each category. A per-product "purchase_link" may also appear: buy without a reviewer's ref link; pay_for_product accepts it as ref_link; no commission or cashback is paid on it.

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

include_all.description: If true, append all non-slotted published reviews after each product's curated slate with slot=overflow; on the discovery path also returns products below the relevance gate (ranked)

intent.description: What the buyer wants, free text. Drives product and review relevance

merchant_id.description: Known product: merchant on-chain NFT ID

price_ceiling.description: Max declared price in USDC atomic units. Products with undeclared price are not filtered out

price_sensitivity.description: How much price should influence ordering, 0–1. 0 (default) ignores price entirely. 1 strongly prefers cheaper AMONG products that already match. Never excludes anything - use price_ceiling for a hard limit. Products with no observed or a stale price are ordered neutrally, neither favoured nor penalised

name: query_registry
